title: fix(community): atomic author voice delete, server-only coach lookup, fresh erasure retry count (#610 carries, B-UGC-5)
body:
**Tier:** T4
**Why:** closes every #610 audit carry under ruling OR-112-6 (before the community launch): durable voice-recording erasure (data deletion), an RLS / SECURITY DEFINER grant change in a new migration, and the retry count of the erasure cron.
**T4 trigger scan:** new migration `20270301000000_community_win_coach_matcher` (RLS policy on "CommunityWin", SECURITY DEFINER function and grants, trigger function body) = T4. Deletion/erasure path for user recordings (privacy) = T4. No CI gate file changes (`.github/workflows/*`, `scripts/ci/*`, `prisma/schema-parity-baseline.sql` untouched). No package or lockfile change. No new env name.
**T3 trigger scan:** community voice service and repository (transaction boundary change), erasure helper used by author delete, moderation and account deletion; account-deletion finalization step 10b (voice erasure transaction boundary, B-UGC-8).
**Bounded T1:** none.
**Builder-owner:** lane B-UGC-8 (agent 114, Claude Opus 5.5 builder; earlier commits by B-UGC-5 and B-UGC-7, agent 113). Owner: operator 114.
**Acceptance evidence:** failing-before tests first (commit 1, tests only, CI red on the new cases), then the fix (commit 2) with every required check green at the head, plus community-live-tests (now required) executing the new C-610-11 live cases on real Postgres.
**Promotion triggers:** none above T4.

## What changes

| Finding (#610 audit) | Change | Test |
|---|---|---|
| C-610-10, author-delete half ("crash window"; Opus 5960733421, Sol 5962580463) | `CommunityVoiceRepository.softDeleteWithErasure` records the erasure work, soft-deletes the note and its search row in ONE `$transaction`; `CommunityVoiceService.deleteAndErase` calls it and tries storage only after the commit. A post-commit erasure-attempt failure is logged and left to `VoiceErasureService` (same rule as moderation Hide/Ban). The non-atomic `softDelete` / `softDeleteSearchEntries` repo methods are removed so no caller can reintroduce the split. | `test/community/safety/community-ugc-b5.spec.ts` (C-610-10 block: mid-delete fault, lost COMMIT, one transaction + storage after commit, post-commit failure, idempotent re-delete); `community-voice.service.spec.ts` delete cases |
| C-610-11 ("open coach-lookup grant") | New migration: boolean matcher `app.community_win_coach_matches(author, coach)` (SECURITY DEFINER, pinned search_path) that answers only for the author or the author's current coach; INSERT policy and the moderation trigger use it; EXECUTE on `app.community_win_author_coach` revoked from `authenticated`. down.sql restores the 20270211 state exactly. | `test/community/rls/community-wins-rls.live.spec.ts` two new C-610-11 cases (community-live-tests); every existing win RLS case stays green |
| C-610-12 ("retry count") | `recordVoiceErasures` re-opens COMPLETED work as a new intent: `attempts` 0, `last_error` null, new `reason`, due now (conditional `updateMany` on `completed_at IS NOT NULL`). Still-open work keeps its count (the >= 10 attempts error log is not reset by a retried request). | `community-ugc-b5.spec.ts` C-610-12 block (3 cases) |
| C-610-10, account-deletion half (B-UGC-8) | `AccountDeletionService.eraseCommunityVoice` reads the notes, records the erasure work and soft-deletes the notes and their search rows in ONE `$transaction` (30 s budget); a failure throws, so finalization stops with nothing committed and the next run retries; storage only after the commit. Before, a soft-delete failure was only logged, leaving live notes with open erasure work (and a crash between the writes did the same). | `test/account-deletion.voice-erasure.spec.ts` two C-610-10 cases; `test/account-deletion.service.spec.ts` now expects both transactions and the tombstone |
| C-610-10, moderation half | Already closed on main by #610 round 6 (B-610-13); no change. | `test/community/safety/community-ugc-round6.spec.ts` |
| C-610-8 ("Bucket not found" counted as deleted) | Already closed on main by #610 round 6 (B-610-8); no change. Regression coverage stays in `src/community/voice/__tests__/voice-erasure-verification.spec.ts`. | existing |
| C-610-9 ("placeholder stall") | Already closed on main by #610 round 6; no change. | existing |

Fixture: `test/account-deletion.voice-erasure.spec.ts` storage-outage case now counts only the attempt updates (`where.completed_at = null`), because the C-610-12 re-open is its own conditional `updateMany`.

## Migration order
Prefix `20270301000000` sorts after every reserved prefix (20270225 to 20270228 are reserved for other lanes). The operator assigns prefixes: rename if another is preferred; nothing else depends on the name.

## Fix round
| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before -> passing after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| C-610-10 author-delete half | `softDeleteWithErasure` (one transaction), storage after commit, post-commit failure left to the cron; non-atomic repo methods removed | dcb5ad63 | `community-ugc-b5.spec.ts` C-610-10 block: 4 of 5 fail at 9a0412bc (the idempotent re-delete case is a regression guard); `community-voice.service.spec.ts` delete cases (6 fail at 9a0412bc); `community-ugc-round2.spec.ts` ordering case rewritten to assert both writes are in the same commit |
| C-610-11 | migration 20270301000000: matcher, INSERT policy, trigger, REVOKE EXECUTE from authenticated | dcb5ad63 | `community-wins-rls.live.spec.ts` "C-610-11: a signed-in role cannot call the coach lookup" and "the boolean matcher answers only for the author or their current coach": both fail in community-live-tests at 9a0412bc (2 failed / 100 passed) |
| C-610-12 | conditional re-open with reset in `recordVoiceErasures` | dcb5ad63 | `community-ugc-b5.spec.ts` C-610-12 block: 2 of 3 fail at 9a0412bc (the still-open case is a guard that the count is NOT reset) |

Failing-before evidence is CI itself: commit 9a0412bc (tests only) ran build-and-test with **12 failed tests, all of them the new cases** (`community-ugc-b5.spec.ts` 6, `community-voice.service.spec.ts` 6), and community-live-tests with **2 failed (the two C-610-11 cases) / 100 passed**. One unrelated suite (`community-message-shape.live.spec.ts`, skipped without a DB in build-and-test) reported "Jest worker ran out of memory" on that run; it is not touched here.

Local after the fix (`heavy.sh env CI=false npx jest --runInBand --forceExit --runTestsByPath ...`): b5, round2, round6, voice service, voice-erasure-verification, account-deletion voice-erasure and service, voice-wins-safety, block-two-way: all pass (live wins RLS spec skips locally, no DB). eslint clean on every changed file; `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=range --base=origin/main --head=HEAD`: OK, no positive token change.

### Fix round 2 (operator seam: #608 merge; B-AUDIT-GATE, agent 114)

Full table: [FIX ROUND 2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/652#issuecomment-5964932299).

| Finding | Fix | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conflict with #608 (account-deletion service + specs) | Merged origin/main `ec911328` and took main's version of the three files; 17606f6c's service change is superseded by #608's single finalization transaction | `01603a0f` | — |
| C-610-10 account half | 17606f6c's two tests ported into main's voice-erasure spec; both pass without a service change | `a22761b5` | voice-erasure 7/7; b5 + manifest coverage + fk-order + engagement 30/30 |

### Fix round 1 (B-UGC-8, agent 114)
| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before -> passing after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CI red at dcb5ad63 | only failure was the known flake `test/ci/release-evidence-gate.spec.ts:367` (1 failed / 11,743 passed); merged origin/main 12e1b03b, then 2e3094b9 (#663 npm audit gate fix) as merge commits | 63dbc59a, fb33823f | all 11 required checks green at fb33823f |
| C-610-10 account-deletion half | one transaction for read + erasure work + note/search soft deletes; failure aborts finalization; storage after commit | 17606f6c | `account-deletion.voice-erasure.spec.ts` "C-610-10: ... ONE transaction, before any storage call" and "C-610-10: a failed note soft delete rolls the erasure work back and stops finalization": both fail at 63dbc59a, pass at 17606f6c |
| C-610-8 / C-610-9 verification | no code change (closed on main); re-run | n/a | `voice-erasure-verification.spec.ts` ("Bucket not found" keeps work open; placeholder-only folder counts empty, a real file behind it does not): pass |

Local at 17606f6c (`heavy.sh env CI=false npx jest --runInBand --forceExit --runTestsByPath ...`): community-ugc-b5, round2, round6, voice-erasure-verification, community-voice.service, account-deletion.service, account-deletion.voice-erasure: 7 suites, all pass. eslint clean on changed files; `check-r75 --mode=range`: OK.

**#608 seam:** no new table or column here, so no erasure-manifest entry. #608 rewrites `finalizeUserDeletion` into one transaction that also records the voice erasure work (closing the same account-deletion half); whichever PR merges second takes #608's side of `src/account-deletion/account-deletion.service.ts`, `test/account-deletion.voice-erasure.spec.ts` and `test/account-deletion.service.spec.ts`.
